calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: saved monochrome MOTIF ABSTRACTION for a future 20-cell-wide by 30-cell-high nonogram, NOT the final colored reveal and NOT a puzzle grid.
EDIT TARGET: the provided approved full-color giraffe A-r01. Preserve this exact animal's identity, side view facing LEFT, upright neck, head angle, two ossicones and visible ears, gently sloping back and body proportions, all FOUR legs and their existing stance, gaps between legs, belly space, right-side tail and tuft. Do not invent a new pose or rotate, squash, widen or crop the animal.
Transform the illustration into a clean BLACK SOLID SILHOUETTE on a pure opaque WHITE background. Black (#000000) foreground and white (#ffffff) background, only slight edge antialiasing permitted. Smooth, confident connected shapes with no texture, gray shading, patterns, isolated ornamental strokes, fine hairs, text, watermark or grid. Remove all coat spots, fur texture, shading, hoof grooves, facial detail and internal mane strokes; their exact detail belongs to the approved colored reveal. Recognition must come from the characteristic long neck, long left-facing muzzle, horns/ears, torso, four legs and tail. Keep important WHITE negative spaces between the legs and under the belly. Ossicone tufts and tail tuft become simple rounded/tapered masses. Merge the short mane into a compact smooth silhouette edge while retaining its line. Gently strengthen the thinnest existing tail/leg connections only as necessary to withstand small 20x30 rasterization, without materially changing proportions or pose. Do NOT turn the giraffe into an outline-only drawing, generic quadruped, pixel art or low-resolution raster.
Canvas exactly 1024x1536, portrait 2:3 like the original. Preserve full giraffe framing with all horns, hooves and tail inside. Avoid large empty margins; tightly useful composition, not stretched. Produce ONE image only.
